dashboard_period: Since launch · dashboard view: Last 1 Year

highlights.title: A caller who could not book online was converted immediately
highlights.summary: After reporting that the online booking flow had not worked for them, a caller asked to reserve a same-day single-player tee time by phone. SpeakSport found the requested 1:40 PM slot, confirmed the junior rate and completed the walking reservation.
highlights.quote: “Absolutely. I can help you book your tee time right now.” SpeakSport then confirmed the caller for 1:40 PM and advised that an email confirmation would follow.

highlights.title: An unavailable request became a confirmed alternative
highlights.summary: When the requested 3:00 PM time was unavailable, SpeakSport clearly repeated the nearest options and the caller selected 4:30 PM. The two-player walking reservation was completed, including senior-status context and confirmation guidance.
highlights.quote: “We don’t have a 3:00 PM tee time available, but we do have 2:30, 4:30, 4:40 and 4:50 PM.”

highlights.title: Senior-player details were applied to a foursome booking
highlights.summary: A caller requested an 8:40 AM tee time for four senior golfers. SpeakSport verified that every player was at least 62, confirmed that the group would ride and completed the reservation with the applicable rate guidance.
highlights.quote: “Your tee time is confirmed for four seniors at 8:40 AM on Monday, August 3, with carts included.”

features_intro: We have continued strengthening the integrated experience around booking accuracy, reservation servicing and clearer operational insight.

features.title: Cancellations on the call
features.description: Golfers can now cancel eligible bookings directly with SpeakSport, reducing avoidable transfers and making it easier to release tee times promptly.

features.title: Stronger booking-eligibility verification
features.description: Booking windows, age categories, customer context and other applicable booking rules are checked before a reservation is created.

features.title: Upcoming-booking confirmations
features.description: When golfers ask about an upcoming reservation, SpeakSport can retrieve and confirm the booking details during the call.

features.title: Richer back-office reporting
features.description: The dashboard now supports filtering calls by intent, category and outcome, making performance patterns and operational opportunities easier to find.

future_note: We will continue enriching SpeakSport with capabilities such as self-serve knowledge-base updates and even better reporting. We would love Oak Hills Park to remain part of that journey—please keep sharing feedback, ideas and initiatives you would like us to explore.

future_priorities.title: Self-serve knowledge base
future_priorities.description: Make it easier for your team to keep rates, policies, facility information and caller guidance current.

future_priorities.title: Even better reporting
future_priorities.description: Add clearer views of booking demand, eligibility, preferred playing times and caller outcomes.
